items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: you’re taking Jimmy Zito’s book with the solos

ctx.x: There was a lot of people. They go in and out, don’t they?

I remember like in ’48 I remember joining Tex Benecke in the Miller band, because Goz says, “Come on the band,” you know, “you’ve got to come on the band.” So I did that. Well before that I was back on the west coast and I joined Les Brown and went the Rich’s Garden was the first gig and we were there and after about a week — and he was such a wonderful guy — I said, “Look, Les, I don’t think I’m going to be traveling.” He said, “Well we’re giving you billing as the feature, you’re taking Jimmy Zito’s book with…
I see. Musically it wasn’t something you thought you could—
